verdicts.reason: Flags §3 and proposes Representatives-only disclosure with need-to-know and written confidentiality obligations at least as protective.
Flags §5 and proposes five years from the Effective Date, with trade-secret confidentiality continuing as long as trade-secret status persists.
Flags §8 as prohibited by the playbook and proposes deleting it entirely without replacement.
Identifies both missing provisions and accepts §1, but explicitly declines to mark all of §10 compliant, reserving venue for attorney review.
Invents no legal authorities, reserves judgment calls for supervising counsel, and explicitly labels the output a draft for attorney review, not legal advice.
